snippet.title: Mafate Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
n Mafate, play as a 📮 mail carrier in Mafate, a remote valley in the 🌊 Indian Ocean.

📸 Take photos and 📜 deliver letters while exploring this 🏞️ picturesque location.

Help Luna, who has been transported to the past in the form of a 📷 camera, assist the locals and uncover the valley’s unique charm ✨.

🛒 Add Mafate to your Steam Wishlist! 🔥👇
📝 Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133220/MAFATE/?beta=0

---Credits---
🎵 Music: Folk_acoustic - PixaBay
